pages.title: Reading a Motion
pages.text: A Special is a direction motion plus an attack button. Different buttons usually give different versions - often changing speed, distance, damage, or recovery. Read {input:236A} left to right: down, down-toward, toward, then A. The game briefly remembers your recent directions, so roll through the motion smoothly and press the button near the end.

pages.title: The Four Common Motions
pages.text: The motions you'll see everywhere are {input:236}, {input:623}, {input:214}, and {input:412} - and Shiori has all four. Do each one and feel how the motion's shape matches the way your inputs move. Tip: ending a motion on a diagonal - {input:23623} instead of {input:236}, {input:21421} instead of {input:214} - comes out more consistently with the game's input buffer.
